name: Cedar Point Park
note: USACE Harlan County Lake park on the south shore at the south end of the dam, off the road to Patterson Harbor: a swim beach with a paved lot and vault toilet, and a primitive camping field on the grassy point around a gravel loop with a second vault toilet. Camping is undesignated: the Corps says to pick a spot with a fire ring and picnic table and pay at the self-pay vault, but a 2021 Dyrt reviewer found no camping sign or fire rings, called the gravel roads narrow and rough, and thought it best for small trailers, vans and pop-ups; call the Corps office to confirm where to camp. Vehicles also drive onto the sand beach below the bluff. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: USACE Kansas City District Harlan County Lake Campgrounds page (live page 403; Wayback capture 2026-02-09, read 2026-11-05): 'Gremlin Cove, North and South Outlets and Cedar Point Park offers more basic experiences to campers. Visitors to these parks are encouraged to select a campsite denoted by the presence of a fire ring and picnic table ... Fees at these parks collected by park rangers on patrol the use of a self-pay vault', fee list 'Cedar Point - $12.00' + USACE Harlan County Lake map (2011) 'Cedar Point Park' with campground/restroom/swimming icons + RIDB facility 248160 'Cedar Point' (USACE, not reservable, updated 2026-02-25) + park sign photo (Dyrt 2021) with tent/swim/fishing icons + Esri Wayback 2015-08-15 GE01 frame showing camping units (one ~7 m long) on the grass around the gravel loop -> real USACE primitive drive-in campground; the camping field is grass off a gravel loop, so the open-beach sand rule does not bar it. Public (federal): no price gate.
waterfront_evidence: 2026-11-05: Esri World Imagery (current, rendered; 0.24-0.78 m/px frames) and Esri Wayback 2015-08-15 GE01 / 2016-07-10 NAIP z17-z18 (rendered) at 40.04939,-99.21665: the camping field is open grass on a bench around the gravel loop; to the north open grass with scattered trees runs ~190 m to the top of a cut-bank bluff (the reviewer's 'dirt cliff'), below which a sand beach runs out to Harlan County Lake (13,000 ac); to the west a double cedar windbreak screens the field from the beach. USGS 3DEP: field 606-607 m, bluff crest 605 m, beach/water 594 m (pool 1,946 ft = 593 m, USACE map) -> the bench is higher than the crest, so the open lake beyond is in line of sight but the near shore is hidden below the bluff; set back ~190 m behind a bluff = lakeview, not lakefront (beach camping is excluded under the sand rule, so it can't earn lakefront). Dam check: the earthen dam's south abutment is ~700 m NE; the field is on the lake (upstream) side of the dam axis and ~13 m above pool, not below the dam.

fees.note: $12 a night (USACE campground fee list, captured February 2026); paid at the self-pay vault or to rangers on patrol.

fees_source: https://web.archive.org/web/20260209025136/https://www.nwk.usace.army.mil/Locations/District-Lakes/Harlan-County-Lake/Campgrounds/, read 2026-11-05: 'Campground Fees ... Gremlin Cove Park - $14.00 North and South Outlet - $12.00 Cedar Point - $12.00'; 'Fees at these parks collected by park rangers on patrol the use of a self-pay vault.' One class only (basic camping), fee shape copied from sibling 2762 South Outlet.
booking_source: https://web.archive.org/web/20260209025136/https://www.nwk.usace.army.mil/Locations/District-Lakes/Harlan-County-Lake/Campgrounds/ (reservations named only for Methodist Cove and Hunter Cove; Cedar Point is 'select a campsite ... self-pay vault'), and RIDB facility 248160 'Cedar Point' Reservable false, no campsites, read 2026-11-05
flags: Duplicate check: the Harlan County Lake entries are 2756 Gremlin Cove (40.0849,-99.2148), 2757 Hunter Cove (40.0832,-99.2282), 2758 Methodist Cove (40.0850,-99.3280), 2762 South Outlet (40.0680,-99.2090, below the dam), 2869 Patterson Harbor Marina (40.0435,-99.2315, private) and 13534 Alma RV Park; none is within 1 km of Cedar Point (nearest: Patterson Harbor ~1.4 km SW, South Outlet ~2.1 km NNE across the dam). No entry named Cedar Point in NE. Other Harlan matches are KY/IA places (1613, 1626, 13509, 13510).

RIDB: a 'Harlan County' search returns rec area 264 facilities Hunter Cove 233517 and Methodist Cove 233551 (reservable campgrounds), Gremlin Cove Shelter 10344872 and High Point Shelter 10346425 (day-use shelters), and non-reservable 'Facility' records Patterson Harbor Marina 248158, North Shore Marina 248159, Cedar Point 248160 (40.04880,-99.21252), Gremlin Cove 248161 and Alma City Park 248162. Cedar Point 248160 has no campsites, no reservation URL and no description beyond 'part of Harlan County Lake'; its point sits in trees ~360 m ESE of the camping field. There is NO North Outlet or South Outlet facility in RIDB. Not on RV Life (Algolia bbox empty for Cedar Point). Google Maps has no Cedar Point place; searches return 'Cedar Run ATV Trail' (40.04778,-99.20846, 4.4/33), a separate USACE area east of the highway (striped on the USACE map, own picnic shelter) - Cedar Point is not an OHV staging camp.

Pin is the grass camping field just west of the gravel loop and its vault toilet (Esri 2015 frame: camping units there). The paved swim-beach lot with its own vault toilet is at ~40.0510,-99.2128, ~370 m NE; RIDB's point (40.04880,-99.21252) is in trees between the two roads.

Rig fit: the Corps gives no length. The only review (The Dyrt, Aug 2021) says 'A small trailer, van, or pop up would be great here', the road to the pit toilet is 'rather rough', roads 'rather narrow, especially if you meet a vehicle pulling a boat', and 'There is not a sign showing camping'; the reviewer drove onto the beach. That is a reviewer opinion (no agency wording), so silent-on-length -> keep with the caveat in the note. Unclear pad size, kept per AWH 2026-11-02.

Sand rule: vehicles visibly camp/park on the open sand beach (2015/2016 imagery, the 2021 review). That beach camping does not count for EKKO; the entry stands on the grass field off the gravel loop, which is a separate developed area (AWH 2026-11-05: a developed loop that also offers beach camping stays).
Waterfront is lakeview on a DEM line-of-sight argument plus open grass on imagery; no dated photo from the camping field exists. If that is judged too inferential, go down to not waterfront.

Structured data for stamping: hookups electric 0 / water false / sewer false (USACE page contrasts Methodist/Hunter Cove 'sites with utilities' with the 'more basic experiences' at Gremlin Cove, the Outlets and Cedar Point; no pedestals on imagery; read 2026-11-05 from the 2026-02-09 capture) - infer with care; sites.count unknown (undesignated); max_rig_ft none stated; pull_through none; booking reservable false, fcfs always (USACE page + RIDB 248160); max_stay_nights 14 is the Corps-wide rule in 36 CFR 327.7(a) ('14 days during any 30-consecutive-day period' at one project) if wanted; facilities: vault toilets (two buildings on imagery; restroom icon on the 2011 USACE map; Dyrt 2021 photo of a two-door vault toilet at the paved lot), swim beach (USACE map icon, corpslakes 'BE'), trash dumpsters (USACE page: 'trash dumpsters provided in each park'); potable water and dump not stated (leave absent); season not stated for Cedar Point (the May-October line on the USACE page is for Methodist and Hunter Cove designated sites; do not copy it).

Lead 12 North Outlet (for its vetter): same USACE page (Feb 2026 capture) - 'North and South Outlet - $12.00', basic camping at fire ring + table, self-pay vault. Not in RIDB (no North Outlet facility). Google Maps 'North Outlet Park' 40.07418,-99.20926, 4.5 on 31 reviews (from 2762's verify_scan). corpslakes.erdc.dren.mil status table (read 2026-11-05) marks North Outlet with Corps fees '$', picnic area 'A', playground 'X', hiking trail 'H'. The 2011 USACE lake map labels 'North Outlet Park' NE of the dam with campground and other icons; it sits below the dam on the outlet channel / Republican River (no lake value). The Dyrt has pages 'harlan-county-lake-coe-north-outlet-park' (review 120400) and 'north-outlet-harlan-county-lake' listing a picnic table, fire ring and mature trees, camping from $12. 2762 South Outlet is the sibling south of the channel - check North Outlet is >1 km and its own entrance (it is on the north side of the outlet channel, reached from Republican City, so likely separate).
